You translate a traveller's one-day trip request in Singapore into a Python program that uses the z3
solver (`import z3`) to find a schedule satisfying EVERY requirement, or prove that none exists.

Facts (times in minutes since midnight, e.g. 09:00 = 540; money in whole SGD):
Places (id | name | cost | typical duration | open-close | showtimes):
peranakan_museum | Peranakan Museum | 15 | 90 | 10:00-19:00 | -
adventure_cove | Adventure Cove Waterpark | 40 | 180 | 10:00-17:00 | -
spectra | Spectra Light and Water Show | 0 | 15 | 19:45-21:30 | 20:00, 21:00
river_cruise | Singapore River Cruise | 28 | 40 | 09:00-22:30 | -
chinatown_complex | Chinatown Complex Food Centre | 8 | 45 | 07:00-22:00 | -
clarke_quay | Clarke Quay | 30 | 90 | 17:00-24:00 | -
singapore_zoo | Singapore Zoo | 49 | 240 | 08:30-18:00 | -
buddha_tooth | Buddha Tooth Relic Temple | 0 | 45 | 07:00-17:00 | -
bird_paradise | Bird Paradise | 49 | 180 | 09:00-18:00 | -
skyhelix | SkyHelix Sentosa | 20 | 30 | 10:00-21:30 | -
oceanarium | Singapore Oceanarium | 50 | 120 | 10:00-19:00 | -
maxwell | Maxwell Food Centre | 8 | 45 | 08:00-24:00 | -
Travel times in minutes between places (row -> column):
peranakan_museum: adventure_cove 23, spectra 14, river_cruise 12, chinatown_complex 14, clarke_quay 12, singapore_zoo 43, buddha_tooth 14, bird_paradise 44, skyhelix 24, oceanarium 23, maxwell 14
adventure_cove: peranakan_museum 23, spectra 23, river_cruise 22, chinatown_complex 20, clarke_quay 22, singapore_zoo 50, buddha_tooth 20, bird_paradise 51, skyhelix 11, oceanarium 11, maxwell 20
spectra: peranakan_museum 14, adventure_cove 23, river_cruise 14, chinatown_complex 15, clarke_quay 14, singapore_zoo 47, buddha_tooth 14, bird_paradise 48, skyhelix 23, oceanarium 23, maxwell 14
river_cruise: peranakan_museum 12, adventure_cove 22, spectra 14, chinatown_complex 12, clarke_quay 11, singapore_zoo 44, buddha_tooth 13, bird_paradise 45, skyhelix 22, oceanarium 21, maxwell 13
chinatown_complex: peranakan_museum 14, adventure_cove 20, spectra 15, river_cruise 12, clarke_quay 13, singapore_zoo 46, buddha_tooth 11, bird_paradise 47, skyhelix 20, oceanarium 19, maxwell 11
clarke_quay: peranakan_museum 12, adventure_cove 22, spectra 14, river_cruise 11, chinatown_complex 13, singapore_zoo 44, buddha_tooth 13, bird_paradise 45, skyhelix 22, oceanarium 22, maxwell 13
singapore_zoo: peranakan_museum 43, adventure_cove 50, spectra 47, river_cruise 44, chinatown_complex 46, clarke_quay 44, buddha_tooth 46, bird_paradise 12, skyhelix 51, oceanarium 50, maxwell 46
buddha_tooth: peranakan_museum 14, adventure_cove 20, spectra 14, river_cruise 13, chinatown_complex 11, clarke_quay 13, singapore_zoo 46, bird_paradise 47, skyhelix 20, oceanarium 19, maxwell 11
bird_paradise: peranakan_museum 44, adventure_cove 51, spectra 48, river_cruise 45, chinatown_complex 47, clarke_quay 45, singapore_zoo 12, buddha_tooth 47, skyhelix 51, oceanarium 51, maxwell 47
skyhelix: peranakan_museum 24, adventure_cove 11, spectra 23, river_cruise 22, chinatown_complex 20, clarke_quay 22, singapore_zoo 51, buddha_tooth 20, bird_paradise 51, oceanarium 11, maxwell 20
oceanarium: peranakan_museum 23, adventure_cove 11, spectra 23, river_cruise 21, chinatown_complex 19, clarke_quay 22, singapore_zoo 50, buddha_tooth 19, bird_paradise 51, skyhelix 11, maxwell 19
maxwell: peranakan_museum 14, adventure_cove 20, spectra 14, river_cruise 13, chinatown_complex 11, clarke_quay 13, singapore_zoo 46, buddha_tooth 11, bird_paradise 47, skyhelix 20, oceanarium 19

Rules of the domain: a visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical one unless the traveller gives one); it must
lie within opening hours; a show may only start at one of its showtimes; visits cannot overlap and consecutive
visits need the travel time between them; must-visit places are required, optional ones may be skipped;
budget is the sum of costs of visited places.

Contract: output ONE python code block. When run, the program must print exactly one final line:
either the word UNSAT, or a JSON list of objects {"location_id": id, "start": minutes, "end": minutes}
for the visited places. Do not read input, do not use the network, do not print anything after that line.

Example of the output format only: [{"location_id": "museum", "start": 540, "end": 660}]

Starting at Maxwell Food Centre, I’ve got the whole day from 09:00 to 23:10 to explore. Budget isn't an issue at all. The one thing I absolutely have to catch is the Spectra Light and Water Show. If I can fit them in, I’d love to check out the Peranakan Museum, Adventure Cove Waterpark, Singapore River Cruise, Chinatown Complex Food Centre, Clarke Quay, Singapore Zoo, Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, Bird Paradise, SkyHelix Sentosa, and the Singapore Oceanarium. Just a heads up, I need to hit Clarke Quay before the Singapore River Cruise.

response:
```python
import json
from z3 import *

places = {
    "peranakan_museum": {"name": "Peranakan Museum", "cost": 15, "dur": 90, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
    "adventure_cove": {"name": "Adventure Cove Waterpark", "cost": 40, "dur": 180, "open": 600, "close": 1020, "shows": []},
    "spectra": {"name": "Spectra Light and Water Show", "cost": 0, "dur": 15, "open": 1185, "close": 1290, "shows": [1200, 1260]},
    "river_cruise": {"name": "Singapore River Cruise", "cost": 28, "dur": 40, "open": 540, "close": 1350, "shows": []},
    "chinatown_complex": {"name": "Chinatown Complex Food Centre", "cost": 8, "dur": 45, "open": 420, "close": 1320, "shows": []},
    "clarke_quay": {"name": "Clarke Quay", "cost": 30, "dur": 90, "open": 1020, "close": 1440, "shows": []},
    "singapore_zoo": {"name": "Singapore Zoo", "cost": 49, "dur": 240, "open": 510, "close": 1080, "shows": []},
    "buddha_tooth": {"name": "Buddha Tooth Relic Temple", "cost": 0, "dur": 45, "open": 420, "close": 1020, "shows": []},
    "bird_paradise": {"name": "Bird Paradise", "cost": 49, "dur": 180, "open": 540, "close": 1080, "shows": []},
    "skyhelix": {"name": "SkyHelix Sentosa", "cost": 20, "dur": 30, "open": 600, "close": 1290, "shows": []},
    "oceanarium": {"name": "Singapore Oceanarium", "cost": 50, "dur": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
    "maxwell": {"name": "Maxwell Food Centre", "cost": 8, "dur": 45, "open": 480, "close": 1440, "shows": []},
}

travel_times = {
    "peranakan_museum": {"adventure_cove": 23, "spectra": 14, "river_cruise": 12, "chinatown_complex": 14, "clarke_quay": 12, "singapore_zoo": 43, "buddha_tooth": 14, "bird_paradise": 44, "skyhelix": 24, "oceanarium": 23, "maxwell": 14, "peranakan_museum": 0},
    "adventure_cove": {"peranakan_museum": 23, "spectra": 23, "river_cruise": 22, "chinatown_complex": 20, "clarke_quay": 22, "singapore_zoo": 50, "buddha_tooth": 20, "bird_paradise": 51, "skyhelix": 11, "oceanarium": 11, "maxwell": 20, "adventure_cove": 0},
    "spectra": {"peranakan_museum": 14, "adventure_cove": 23, "river_cruise": 14, "chinatown_complex": 15, "clarke_quay": 14, "singapore_zoo": 47, "buddha_tooth": 14, "bird_paradise": 48, "skyhelix": 23, "oceanarium": 23, "maxwell": 14, "spectra": 0},
    "river_cruise": {"peranakan_museum": 12, "adventure_cove": 22, "spectra": 14, "chinatown_complex": 12, "clarke_quay": 11, "singapore_zoo": 44, "buddha_tooth": 13, "bird_paradise": 45, "skyhelix": 22, "oceanarium": 21, "maxwell": 13, "river_cruise": 0},
    "chinatown_complex": {"peranakan_museum": 14, "adventure_cove": 20, "spectra": 15, "river_cruise": 12, "clarke_quay": 13, "singapore_zoo": 46, "buddha_tooth": 11, "bird_paradise": 47, "skyhelix": 20, "oceanarium": 19, "maxwell": 11, "chinatown_complex": 0},
    "clarke_quay": {"peranakan_museum": 12, "adventure_cove": 22, "spectra": 14, "river_cruise": 11, "chinatown_complex": 13, "singapore_zoo": 44, "buddha_tooth": 13, "bird_paradise": 45, "skyhelix": 22, "oceanarium": 22, "maxwell": 13, "clarke_quay": 0},
    "singapore_zoo": {"peranakan_museum": 43, "adventure_cove": 50, "spectra": 47, "river_cruise": 44, "chinatown_complex": 46, "clarke_quay": 44, "buddha_tooth": 46, "bird_paradise": 12, "skyhelix": 51, "oceanarium": 50, "maxwell": 46, "singapore_zoo": 0},
    "buddha_tooth": {"peranakan_museum": 14, "adventure_cove": 20, "spectra": 14, "river_cruise": 13, "chinatown_complex": 11, "clarke_quay": 13, "singapore_zoo": 46, "bird_paradise": 47, "skyhelix": 20, "oceanarium": 19, "maxwell": 11, "buddha_tooth": 0},
    "bird_paradise": {"peranakan_museum": 44, "adventure_cove": 51, "spectra": 48, "river_cruise": 45, "chinatown_complex": 47, "clarke_quay": 45, "singapore_zoo": 12, "buddha_tooth": 47, "skyhelix": 51, "oceanarium": 51, "maxwell": 47, "bird_paradise": 0},
    "skyhelix": {"peranakan_museum": 24, "adventure_cove": 11, "spectra": 23, "river_cruise": 22, "chinatown_complex": 20, "clarke_quay": 22, "singapore_zoo": 51, "buddha_tooth": 20, "bird_paradise": 51, "oceanarium": 11, "maxwell": 20, "skyhelix": 0},
    "oceanarium": {"peranakan_museum": 23, "adventure_cove": 11, "spectra": 23, "river_cruise": 21, "chinatown_complex": 19, "clarke_quay": 22, "singapore_zoo": 50, "buddha_tooth": 19, "bird_paradise": 51, "skyhelix": 11, "maxwell": 19, "oceanarium": 0},
    "maxwell": {"peranakan_museum": 14, "adventure_cove": 20, "spectra": 14, "river_cruise": 13, "chinatown_complex": 11, "clarke_quay": 13, "singapore_zoo": 46, "buddha_tooth": 11, "bird_paradise": 47, "skyhelix": 20, "oceanarium": 19, "maxwell": 0}
}

def get_travel(p1, p2):
    return travel_times.get(p1, {}).get(p2, 0)

opt = Optimize()

ids = list(places.keys())
visit = {p: Bool(f"visit_{p}") for p in ids}
start = {p: Int(f"start_{p}") for p in ids}
end = {p: Int(f"end_{p}") for p in ids}

# Maxwell is starting point and must be visited
opt.add(visit["maxwell"] == True)
# Spectra is mandatory
opt.add(visit["spectra"] == True)

# Time bounds: 09:00 (540) to 23:10 (1390)
DAY_START = 540
DAY_END = 1390

for p in ids:
    p_info = places[p]
    dur = p_info["dur"]
    opt.add(start[p] >= DAY_START)
    opt.add(end[p] <= DAY_END)
    opt.add(end[p] == start[p] + dur)
    
    # Opening hours
    opt.add(Implies(visit[p], start[p] >= p_info["open"]))
    opt.add(Implies(visit[p], end[p] <= p_info["close"]))
    
    # Showtimes constraint
    if p_info["shows"]:
        show_constraints = [start[p] == s for s in p_info["shows"]]
        opt.add(Implies(visit[p], Or(show_constraints)))

# Specific ordering constraint: Clarke Quay before Singapore River Cruise
opt.add(Implies(And(visit["clarke_quay"], visit["river_cruise"]), end["clarke_quay"] + get_travel("clarke_quay", "river_cruise") <= start["river_cruise"]))

# Non-overlap and travel time constraints between all pairs of visited places
for i in range(len(ids)):
    for j in range(len(ids)):
        if i != j:
            p1 = ids[i]
            p2 = ids[j]
            t_travel = get_travel(p1, p2)
            # If both visited, p1 finishes + travel <= p2 starts OR p2 finishes + travel <= p1 starts
            opt.add(Implies(And(visit[p1], visit[p2]),
                            Or(end[p1] + t_travel <= start[p2],
                               end[p2] + t_travel <= start[p1])))

# Maximize number of visited places (to include as many as possible)
total_visited = Sum([If(visit[p], 1, 0) for p in ids])
opt.maximize(total_visited)

if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    result = []
    for p in ids:
        if m.eval(visit[p]):
            result.append({
                "location_id": p,
                "start": m.eval(start[p]).as_long(),
                "end": m.eval(end[p]).as_long()
            })
    # Sort by start time
    result.sort(key=lambda x: x["start"])
    print(json.dumps(result))
else:
    print("UNSAT")
```
